summary: Styles for input fields, body, and login page components.
evidence: `.inputField` styles for input fields with a light transparent background, blue border, and glow effect on focus.
`.black` styles for a centered, semi-transparent box with a white background.
`.loginPageChild` styles for a centered, semi-transparent box with a blue background.
`.student` styles for an image positioned in the login page.
`.unionIcon` styles for an image positioned at the top left.
`.unionIcon1` styles for an image positioned at the right side.
`.unionIcon2` styles for an image positioned at the bottom.
`.loginBox` styles for a box positioned on the right side of the login page.
